meta.name: agent-tools
meta.description: Run 150+ AI apps via inference.sh CLI - image generation, video creation, LLMs, search, 3D, Twitter automation. Models: FLUX, Veo, Gemini, Grok, Claude, Seedance, OmniHuman, Tavily, Exa, OpenRouter, and many more. Use when running AI apps, generating images/videos, calling LLMs, web search, or automating Twitter. Triggers: inference.sh, infsh, ai model, run ai, serverless ai, ai api, flux, veo, claude api, image generation, video generation, openrouter, tavily, exa search, twitter api, grok

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用一条命令调用 150 多种 AI 应用,完成出图、视频和问答
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要快速调用各种 AI 模型来生成内容或获取信息
copy.tagline_en: Run 150+ AI apps from one CLI for images, video, chat, and search.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly call AI models to generate content or get information.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 infsh 命令行调用 150+ 个云端 AI 应用：生成图片、视频、3D 模型，调用大语言模型，做网页搜索，或发布推特，按你的指令完成并返回结果。
howto.when: 当你说出“inference.sh”“infsh”等关键词，或要求生成图片/视频、调用大模型、做网页搜索时触发。

say.text: 用 FLUX 生成一张宇航员猫的图片
用 Veo 3.1 生成一段无人机飞过山脉的视频
用 Tavily 搜一下最新 AI 新闻

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the infsh CLI to run 150+ cloud AI apps: generate images, videos, 3D models, call LLMs, perform web searches, or post tweets, following your instructions and returning results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "inference.sh" or "infsh", or ask to generate images/videos, call LLMs, or do web searches.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a cat astronaut with FLUX.
Generate a video of a drone flying over mountains with Veo 3.1.
Search the latest AI news with Tavily.
